tamus.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. "Ecclesam" is printed as "Ecclesam" with the letter i apparently missing; marked [?]. "Duum" is faint and marked [?]. "tantopere" has a stop or blot before "e" and is marked [?]. The printed "tamus." at the end of the first paragraph is the word "admittamus" with its final part on the line. The catchword "re" completes "late-re" on the next page.
